title: 나이가 어떻게 돼?
scene: 동아리 첫 모임. 민준이 처음 만나자마자 나이를 묻는다
goal: Why Koreans ask your age first (형·누나·오빠·언니)

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Hi! If you don't mind, how old are you?
turns.note: 나이가 어떻게 되세요? = how old are you? (polite)

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Uh… we just met and you ask my age?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Oh, so I know how to talk to you! What year were you born?
turns.note: 말 놓다 = speak casually · 몇 년생 = born what year

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 헐, 저보다 한 살 많네요. 그럼 형이네!
turns.rd: heol, jeoboda han sal manneyo. geureom hyeongine!
turns.en: Whoa, one year older than me. Then you're my 형!

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 네, 형! 형, 뭐 드실래요? 제가 살게요.
turns.rd: ne, hyeong! hyeong, mwo deusillaeyo? jega salgeyo.
turns.en: Yes, 형! 형, what will you have? My treat.
turns.note: Kick: instant hierarchy, instant free meal

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: …You buy a meal over one year?
